Store.title: Store
Store.description: Represents an online store within the MiBazar application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Store entity.

slug.description: A URL-friendly version of the store name.

ownerId.description: Reference to the User who owns the store. (Relationship: User 1:N Store)

isActive.description: Indicates whether the store is currently active.

phone.description: The contact phone number for the store.

whatsapp.description: The WhatsApp contact number for the store.

socials.description: An object containing social media URLs for the store.

state.description: The state in Mexico where the store is located.

municipality.description: The municipality or delegation where the store is located.

bannerUrl.description: URL or Base64 data URI for the store's banner image.

bannerHint.description: Hint for AI to find a relevant banner image.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product sold in a store.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Product entity.

storeId.description: Reference to the Store this product belongs to. (Relationship: Store 1:N Product)

ownerId.description: Reference to the User who owns the store and product.

costPrice.description: The cost price of the product.

price.description: The selling price of the product.

stock.description: The current stock level of the product.

category.description: The category the product belongs to.

imageUrl.description: URL of the product image stored in Firebase Storage.

imageHint.description: Hint for AI to find a relevant image.

SaleTicket.title: SaleTicket
SaleTicket.description: Represents a sales ticket for a transaction in a store.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SaleTicket entity.

storeId.description: Reference to the Store where the sale occurred. (Relationship: Store 1:N SaleTicket)

ownerId.description: Reference to the User who owns the store.

ticketNumber.description: Automatically generated sequential number for the sales ticket.

totalSales.description: The total sales amount for the ticket.

productIds.description: References to Products included in the sale. (Relationship: SaleTicket 1:N Product)

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the MiBazar application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

role.description: The role of the user, determining their permissions.

storeId.description: The ID of the active store selected by the user.

Rating.title: Rating
Rating.description: Represents a rating given to a store by a user.

storeId.description: The ID of the store being rated.

userId.description: The ID of the user who gave the rating.

comment.description: An optional comment with the rating.

date.description: The date the rating was given.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user.

params.name: productId
params.description: The unique identifier for the product.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed for a multi-tenant e-commerce platform. The key change is elevating `products` and `stores` to top-level collections. This is critical for the buyer-facing part of the application, as it allows for efficient, unauthenticated queries across all products (e.g., for a public catalog page with filtering). Security is maintained by denormalizing `ownerId` and `storeId` into each document. Security rules will use these denormalized fields to ensure that only the rightful owner can write to their own documents, while allowing global reads for public data.
